row_register: Fixed finite rows and supplied finite alphabets containing true support
sampling_law: The selected row is chosen before seeing the outcome; conditional on the whole pre-outcome history it has its fixed registered law
sampling_schedule: Predictable row choices and arbitrary stopping; no termination or infinite-visitation assumption
error_allocation: Fixed alpha strictly between zero and one; positive predeclared row weights sum at most one; n-th-visit allowance alpha*w/[n(n+1)]
unsampled_rows: Radius one for unobserved unknown multi-symbol rows; radius zero for known or supplied singleton rows
all_known_case: Maximum error includes zero, so an empty unknown register gives error zero
numerical_contract: Exact rational arithmetic, positive Taylor lower bound on exp, least passing radius on grid j/n; no optimal-width claim
transfer: Inherited FMT sufficient-state, common-policy, legal/start/success/known-cost and finite-horizon contract
